MERGE INTO NYEHMS_OWNER.CDC_RIDR_INFO out USING ( SELECT * FROM ( SELECT a.rowid row_id , pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE
, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY pdoc.stateno, a.REPORTING_JURISDICTION, a.STATENO ORDER BY pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE DESC) rn FROM CDC_RIDR_INFO a, RAW_ACRF_RIDR_INFO b, RAW_ACRF_DOC c , person_doc_association pdoc , coded_state st WHERE a.FILE_NAME = #{fileName} and a.RESOLVED_DATE is null and b.ACRF_DOC_ID = c.document_id and c.DOCUMENT_SOURCE in ('A06.18', 'A06.29') and c.document_id = pdoc.document_id and pdoc.DISSASSOCIATION_DATE is null
AND ABS(Trunc(pdoc.ASSOCIATION_DATE ) - Trunc(SYSDATE)) <= 90
and upper(st.STATE_DESCRIPTION) = upper(a.REPORTING_JURISDICTION) and b.STATE_CD = st.state_code and b.STATENO = a.STATENO and pdoc.stateno = PKG_CONSOLIDATION.FN_GIVE_CURRENT_STATENO (a.NYS_STATENO)
) WHERE rn = 1 ) m ON (out.rowid = m.row_id) WHEN MATCHED THEN UPDATE SET PARENT_DOC_EXISTS = 'Y', PARENT_DOC_CREATE_DT = ASSOCIATION_DATE
